decision.reason: [ev-8c9f143ab334] is only a changelog line saying image-automation-controller was updated to v1.0.1. It doesn't say what changed in that version or what happens to an operator. "None" treats silence as proof that nothing changes, but the rules say that when the evidence doesn't say what happens, the consequence is undetermined. To decide, we need the image-automation-controller v1.0.1 changelog or release notes, plus the previous bundled version.
